allow: PowerShell(netstat -ano | Select-String ":3000" | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[-1] } | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\d+$') { taskkill /PID $_ /F 2>$null } })

hooks.command: $msgFile = '.claude/commit_msg.txt'; if (Test-Path $msgFile) { $msg = (Get-Content $msgFile -Raw).Trim(); Remove-Item $msgFile } else { $msg = $null }; git add -A; $staged = git diff --cached --name-only 2>$null; if ($staged) { if (-not $msg) { $files = ($staged -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { Split-Path $_ -Leaf }) -join ', '; $msg = "auto: $files" }; git commit -m $msg; git push origin main 2>$null }
